_comment: This is the SHAPE of your config, not your config. The setup wizard (/ig-setup) writes the real file to config/user_config.json, which is gitignored. Never edit this template with real data.

competitors._north_star_threshold_note: Default is 500k. Lower this per-niche if the niche is too young to have mega-accounts yet, so the North Stars tier isn't permanently empty.

cadence._radar_frequency_note: This is a label describing intended cadence, not automated scheduling — /ig-radar is manually triggered. The queue architecture is designed to tolerate irregular timing gracefully, so running a bit late doesn't break anything. See docs/troubleshooting.md if you want to explore real OS-level scheduling yourself.

delivery._mode_note: Only claude_chat is actually implemented right now — email/Slack are collected as a preference for future work but don't do anything yet. The wizard is upfront about this.

budget_caps_usd._note: These are safety ceilings for a single call, not the PRD's cost-model targets. They're set with margin above real observed Apify billing (validated via live testing on a prior build), which in some cases ran meaningfully higher than initial estimates — see docs/how-to-get-apify-token.md for the honest real-world cost breakdown.

scoring._comment: 100-point weighted outlier score. Absorbed from the social-media-marketing-specialist skill — see lib/outlier_scoring.py header for credit.
